name: DC Super Hero Girls
description: At Super Hero High, iconic Super Heroes like Wonder Woman, Supergirl, Batgirl, Harley Quinn, Bumblebee, Poison Ivy, and Katana navigate all the twists and turns of high school. United by friendship, the DC Super Hero Girls empower kids to shine with confidence and courage, especially while they combat those overwhelming, exciting, and awesomely awkward moments of growing up (sometimes super powers can be super stressful!).

videos.title: Welcome to Super Hero High
videos.overview: It’s the start of a brand new year at Super Hero High School!!! Follow your favorite DC Super Hero Girls as they experience the ups, downs and all-arounds on their first day of school.

videos.title: All About Super Hero High
videos.overview: It’s a big day for everyone at Super Hero High School! Wonder Woman has finally touched down on campus and she’s ready to make her mark, but she still has a lot to learn.

videos.title: Roomies
videos.overview: Meeting new friends is really exciting, but living with them can get really messy! Find out which two Super Heroes end up as roommates.

videos.title: Crazy Quiltin'
videos.overview: It's time for the first project of the year! Bust out your pencils and help Wonder Woman design a Super Suit that'll bring out her true colors in the halls of Super Hero High School.

videos.title: Power Outage
videos.overview: It’s time for the girls to test their super power skills! Find out who passes with flying colors and who doesn’t at Super Hero High School. The answer might surprise you.

videos.title: Fall Into Super Hero High
videos.overview: Harley Quinn has organized a movie night, premiering a compilation of footage starring the girls, but what will the others think of it?

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Poison Ivy
videos.overview: Let's hear it for Our Hero of the Month at Super Hero High: Poison Ivy! Not only has she rescued classmates, friends and strangers, but you'll be amazed at how many sticky situations she's stopped from getting worse!

videos.title: Designing Disaster
videos.overview: The end of the semester is nearing, but is Wonder Woman's Super Suit going to land her an A+?

videos.title: Weaponomics
videos.overview: Wonder Woman sure knows her weaponomics, but a certain someone doesn't want her teacher to know. What happens in class will surprise you!

videos.title: Clubbing
videos.overview: It's time for Poison Ivy to branch out (literally) and join some clubs. Principal's orders! But what club should she choose at Super Hero High School!?

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Bumblebee
videos.overview: It's Bumblebee's time to shine for her heroic prowess, exceptional flying skills and great taste in music!! Follow along as she accepts this exciting honor from Super Hero High School!

videos.title: Saving the Day
videos.overview: It's the end of the semester for Super Hero High students, but wait! A Save the Day alarm has sounded and they must fly to the rescue!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Wonder Woman
videos.overview: Drum roll, please...for our Our Hero of the Month! Wonder Woman's best known for being a leader and a great friend, which is why Super Hero High nominated her!

videos.title: New Beginnings
videos.overview: Wonder Woman is living her destiny! As the newly appointed School Ambassador, she's taking the lead to recruit Supergirl to Super Hero High — until a sneak attack from villainess Giganta catches her off guard.

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Supergirl
videos.overview: Supergirl may be new to Super Hero High, but she's already a BIG hit. With her smashing entrances and out-of-control enthusiasm, Supergirl soars as Hero of the Month!

videos.title: Batgirl vs. Supergirl
videos.overview: Batgirl and Supergirl face-off in their greatest battle yet — the last piece of superfood cake! Find out who is quick enough to snag it.

videos.title: Quinntessential Harley
videos.overview: Harley Quinn's video blog has gone viral! Can she handle the responsibility of being a Super Hero AND a celebrity?

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Harley Quinn
videos.overview: TA-DA! Hero of the Month is Harley Quinn! She saves the day in crazy fun ways and laughs in the face of danger.

videos.title: License to Fly
videos.overview: The Batjet is ready for lift-off. But first, Batgirl must maneuver her way through the Flyer's Ed test. Find out if she has the skills to ace the exam!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Batgirl
videos.overview: A round of applause for the newest Hero of the Month — Batgirl! She's the resident computer genius at Super Hero High and can solve problems faster than a calculator. w00t!

videos.title: Doubles Trouble
videos.overview: Katana chooses Supergirl as her tennis doubles partner, but Supergirl’s powers are too much for the game.

videos.title: Franken-Ivy
videos.overview: Poison Ivy's new plant is growing faster than anyone expected. Can the DC Super Hero Girls stop it from taking over Metropolis?

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Katana
videos.overview: She's fast. She's fierce. She's fashionable. Give it up for Katana — an expert swordswoman and the newest Hero of the Month!

videos.title: Dude, Where's My Invisible Jet?
videos.overview: When Wonder Woman's invisible jet goes missing, her friends band together to form a search party. You'll never guess where they find it!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Frost
videos.overview: Whether it's fighting super villains or solving complex chemistry equations, Frost always keeps her cool. See her in action as Hero of the Month!

videos.title: Blunder Games
videos.overview: As part of the Advanced Survival Skills class, Batgirl is dropped off in a remote island and must make it to the designated meeting spot before sunset. But when her equipment malfunctions, Batgirl must rely on a different set of super skills.

videos.title: Hawkgirl's Day Off
videos.overview: As a break from classes and hall monitoring, Hawkgirl's friends treat her to a relaxing day at the SuperSpa. But the day takes a turn when the fearsome Mrs. Clayface makes a surprise appearance!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Hawkgirl
videos.overview: Hawkgirl is a serious a force to be reckoned with. She's the best Hall Monitor at Super Hero High, a fearless defender of justice, and most of all, a loyal and loving friend. Congrats to the new Hero of the Month!

videos.title: The Cheetah Who Cried Wolf
videos.overview: Overcome with jealousy, Cheetah tries to become Hero of the Month after a series of staged (and failed) attempts. So when the evil Soloman Grundy actually attacks, no one believes Cheetah and she must take on the villain herself.

videos.title: Ring of Mire
videos.overview: When Star Sapphire accidentally drops her violet lantern ring down the sink, she dives into the sewer to find it — only to be greeted the evil villain Croc!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Star Sapphire
videos.overview: Star Sapphire graces the halls of Super Hero High with the perfect OOTD, but she also knows how to lay down the law with her powerful violet lantern ring. Rock that Hero of the Month, Star Sapphire!

videos.title: Ultimate Accessory
videos.overview: The pressure is on! Bumblebee must design a high-tech accessory for her Weaponomics class. Will her final product get a passing grade?

videos.title: Riddle of the Heart
videos.overview: With her expert detective skills, Batgirl has been able to solve mysteries in the blink of an eye...until now. Find out who's behind a series of puzzling new riddles.

videos.title: Heros of the Month: Cyborg and Starfire
videos.overview: For the first time ever, Principal Waller is naming TWO Heroes of the Month - the half man, half robot Cyborg and the Tamaranian warrior-princess Starfire! Their teamwork and friendship prove that superpowers are much better used together.

videos.title: Roomies Return: Frost's Bite
videos.overview: When Frost can't find a way to warm up, she takes her bitter coldness out on her classmates. Bundle up!

videos.title: Odd Couple
videos.overview: Surprise! Harley Quinn and Lady Shiva are paired up as partners for their Advanced Stakeout project. Can they look past their differences to catch the sly villain Cheshire? Or will their assignment turn into an epic fail?

videos.title: Cold Blooded
videos.overview: Frost has a cold, and every sneeze starts a mini snowstorm!

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Lady Shiva
videos.overview: It's clear that Lady Shiva has been training to become Hero of the Month. She's one of the only Super Heroes who can calculate AND dish out the perfect punch!

videos.title: Batnapped
videos.overview: Batgirl is kidnapped by Killer Moth, who wants to make her his partner! Too bad Batgirl already has a partner -- Supergirl!

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: Harley Quinn enlists the help of Katana and Bumblebee in hiding a surprise birthday present for Batgirl in her dorm room. But when they sneak into Batgirl’s dorm, they are accosted by Batgirl’s booby traps.

videos.title: Hero of the Month: Beast Boy
videos.overview: Hero of the Month goes to Beast Boy! Whether he transforms into a ferocious crocodile or an friendly octopus, Beast Boy always saves the day in unexpected ways.

videos.title: Tales from the Kryptomites Part 1
videos.overview: Lena Luthor uses kryptonite remnants from Supergirl's ship to create living Kryptomites.

videos.title: Tales from the Kryptomites Part 2
videos.overview: The supers must save Metropolis from the army of Kryptomites.

videos.title: Seeing Red
videos.overview: A red Kryptomite loose at Super Hero High brings out everyone's mean side.

videos.title: Spring Prison Break
videos.overview: Frost reads her “How I Spent Spring Break” essay and we flashback to the tale of how Katana and Frost formed the first “Task Force X” to stop Lashina from breaking the Female Furies out of Belle Reve. During the battle between the SHH Heroes and the Furies, Barda redeems herself and joins the side of the good guys.

videos.title: Around Metropolis in 80 Seconds
videos.overview: Wonder Woman and Supergirl are facing off to see who’s fastest, but when they keep tying, they decide to race sans-superpowers. Harley hates to be left out and joins the race. As Wonder Woman and Supergirl zoom around Metropolis, they spot a bank robbery in progress and compete to see who can catch the criminals first.

videos.title: For Art's Sake
videos.overview: It’s the SHH Student Art Fundraiser and the Double Dare Twins have stolen masterpiece from the show! It’s up to Katana and Supergirl to stop them and recover the painting. But when Supergirl is knocked out by kryptonite and Katana’s sword is stolen, Katana must improvise and use her art supplies to defeat the Double Dare Twins.

videos.title: Wildside Part 1
videos.overview: Batgirl, Beast Boy and Starfire are picnicking in the park when Lion-Mane’s menagerie of entranced animals attack the park! The heroes must save the citizens and stop Lion-Mane.

videos.title: Wildside Part 2
videos.overview: With Lion-Mane subdued, Batgirl, Starfire, and Beast Boy must find all the escaped zoo animals and return them to the zoo.

videos.title: Day of Fun-Ship
videos.overview: Starfire and Blackfire must protect the zoo from King Shark. The sisters realize they have more in common than they thought.

videos.title: The Ares Up There
videos.overview: When Wonder Woman is home for a holiday, Ares takes advantage and attacks her people. Is she strong enough to stop the almighty God of War?

videos.title: Stealth 101 Part 1
videos.overview: Batgirl and Poison Ivy are partnered for Crazy Quilt's stealth suit design project.

videos.title: Stealth 101 Part 2
videos.overview: Batgirl and Poison Ivy use their stealth suits to rescue Crazy Quilt from Killer Moth.

videos.title: A Fury Scorned
videos.overview: Lashina breaks into Belle Reve and poisons Commissioner Gordon. Batgirl and Hawkgirl must find the antidote before it's too late!

videos.title: Body Electric
videos.overview: Giganta causes an electric blackout and Batgirl enlists the help of Thunder and Lightning.

videos.title: Techless Tuesday
videos.overview: Mrs. Clayface steals all of Batgirl's gadgets in an effort to break her husband out of Arkham.

videos.title: Fresh Ares Pt. 1
videos.overview: Peaced-out Ares comes to Metropolis to see Wonder Woman, but his peaceful outlook is ruined when Catwoman steals the amulet of Harmonia.

videos.title: Fresh Ares Pt. 2
videos.overview: As Ares rains destruction on Metropolis, the supers must recover the amulet of Harmonia.

videos.title: Fresh Ares Pt. 3
videos.overview: With Catwoman's help, the supers return the amulet of Harmonia to Ares and save the day.

videos.title: Gorilla Warfare
videos.overview: The supers must save Gorilla Grodd when his former army comes to "rescue" him from Super Hero High.

videos.title: Fight Flub
videos.overview: Katana and Big Barda try to prove their own fighting style is the best when the Double Dare Twins attack.

videos.title: Jetsetters
videos.overview: Wonder Woman is trying to teach Frost how to fly the invisible jet so she can pass her flyers exam when Killer Moth attacks.

videos.title: A New Perry-spective
videos.overview: Perry the Parademon is loose in Metropolis and the heroes are on the trail! But Big Barda has a soft spot for the parademon and takes him in as her new pet.

videos.title: It's a Superful Life
videos.overview: The heroes want to make this an extra special holiday by brightening the lives of Metropolis citizens.

videos.title: Ring Me Maybe Part 1
videos.overview: Green Lantern is leaving Earth and joining the Green Lantern Corp, but will Earth be safe before a new Green Lantern is called?

videos.title: Ring Me Maybe Part 2
videos.overview: With Hal Jordan gone, Sinestro seizes the opportunity to attack Earth! Will the new Green Lantern arrive in time to save the day?

videos.title: Ring Me Maybe Part 3
videos.overview: Jessica Cruz has been chosen as Earth's new Green Lantern! But will fear keep her from stopping Sinestro and embracing her powers?

videos.title: Ring Me Maybe Part 4
videos.overview: Jessica Cruz conquers her fears and faces Sinestro with a little help from her super hero friends!

videos.title: Fish Out of Water Part 1
videos.overview: Mera is having a hard time adjusting to her life at Super Hero High, but with the help of her new friends, Super Hero High will feel like home.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water Part 2
videos.overview: Mera must team up with Miss Martian to put a stop on Firefly's rampage.

videos.title: Gone to the Dogs Part 1
videos.overview: Batgirl and Supergirl may be best friends, but their dogs Krypto and Ace are still getting to know each other! Can they put aside their differences to help save the day?

videos.title: Gone to the Dogs Part 2
videos.overview: While Supergirl and Batgirl investigate a burglary, Krypto and Ace track the culprit and reclaim the loot.

videos.title: Pets Peeved, Part 1
videos.overview: The Super Pets are on the verge of failing their first class at Super Hero High, but when the Animilitia traps the heroes, the Super Pets must prove their heroic mettle to save their owners.

videos.title: Pets Peeved, Part 2
videos.overview: The Super Pets work together to save their owners and stop the Animilitia, proving they are a part of the Super Team!

videos.title: Ha-Ha Horticulture
videos.overview: When Ivy's plant experiment goes awry and puts the whole school to sleep, it's up to her and Harley to find the antidote.

videos.title: Truth of the Lasso, Part 1
videos.overview: Wonder Woman evades Cheetah's repeated attempts to steal her Lasso of Truth, but Wonder Woman loses her lasso during an encounter with Giganta.

videos.title: Truth of the Lasso, Part 2
videos.overview: When Wonder Woman's lasso goes missing, the origin story of her lasso comes to light -- which is also the origin story of Cheetah's powers!

videos.title: Truth of the Lasso, Part 3
videos.overview: The Super Hero High kids are headed on a field trip, but their journey is cut short by Giganta's attack.

videos.title: Truth of the Lasso, Part 4
videos.overview: Cheetah tries to get her revenge on Wonder Woman by using her own lasso against her, but Wonder Woman overcomes Cheetah's treachery.

videos.title: Nevermore, Part 1
videos.overview: Trigon wants his daughter Raven to follow in his footsteps and rule the Underworld, but Raven isn't so sure…

videos.title: Nevermore, Part 2
videos.overview: Raven helps save Metropolis after her portal causes an Earthquake, and discovers she wants to study at Super Hero High!

videos.title: Nevermore, Part 3
videos.overview: Trigon reeks havoc on Super Hero High when he hears Raven wants to attend, and it's up to the Supers to stop him!

videos.title: Nevermore, Part 4
videos.overview: Raven uses her magic to help stop her father Trigon, and might just convince him to let her stay at Super Hero High…

videos.title: Drive Me Crazy
videos.overview: When Wonder Woman, Batgirl and Harley discover that Big Barda doesn't know how to drive, they set out to teach her.

videos.title: Tamaranean Dance Club, Part 1
videos.overview: Starfire is homesick for a traditional Tamaranean dance so the Supers surprise her with one of their own!

videos.title: Tamaranean Dance Club, Part 2
videos.overview: Starfire is feeling melancholy and homesick for the great dance of Tamaran. Supergirl, Katana and Wonder Woman organize a dance with Starfire's evil elder sister Blackfire and the Korugar Academy kids, but "dance" in Tamaranean means something else entirely.

videos.title: Fly By Night
videos.overview: To reclaim Wonder Woman's homework after curfew, Wonder Woman, Bumblebee and Hawkgirl must sneak by the teachers to get to the cafeteria where the project was left.

videos.title: By the Yearbook
videos.overview: Harley Quinn and Wonder Woman are co-editors of the yearbook, but their opinions on what's yearbook worthy collide.

videos.title: Spell-shocked, Part 1
videos.overview: After creating a portal to the future Raven will enlist the help of Wonder Woman and Batgirl to return her memory!

videos.title: Spell-shocked, Part 2
videos.overview: Raven and the DC Super Hero Girls must unite to protect the school from the magical Book of Legends!

videos.title: Kid Napped
videos.overview: Batgirl is babysitting Robin when a sinister shadow creature appears. What could possibly go wrong?

videos.title: Bottle Episode
videos.overview: Supergirl must save the Bottled City of Kandor from her school trash processor.

videos.title: Career Day
videos.overview: It's Career Day at Super Hero High and Wonder Woman is learning from the school janitor, Parasite.

videos.title: Mood Ring
videos.overview: Emotions run wild when Star Sapphire breaks her ring. Can she get everything back to normal before super feelings destroy the school?

videos.title: Stage Fright
videos.overview: While the girls are preparing for the Super Hero High school play, Raven casts a good luck spell which doesn't quite go to plan.

videos.title: Hackgirl
videos.overview: When Hawkgirl receives an unpredictable gadget upgrade from Batgirl she struggles to fight off Cheshire.

videos.title: My New Best Friend
videos.overview: When Batgirl loses her memory, she is tricked by Catwoman into teaming up and committing crimes.

videos.title: Anti-Hall Monitor, Part 1
videos.overview: In an attempt to get around the ever watchful eye of Hawkgirl, Batgirl creates a sinister app to track her whereabouts.

videos.title: Anti-Hall Monitor, Part 2
videos.overview: The Anti-Hall monitor app is out of control and Hawkgirl must come out of retirement to fix Batgirl's mistake.

videos.title: Haunted Harley
videos.overview: After being sent to detention, Harley Quinn becomes convinced that Super Hero High is haunted!

videos.title: All Pets Are Off
videos.overview: It’s Pet Day at Super Hero High and DC Heroes such as Wonder Woman, Harley Quinn, The Flash and Batgirl have brought along some of the bravest animals they know to compete in the competition. But when some of the Super-Pets start to mysteriously disappear, the heroes will have to enlist the help of the Teen Titans shape-shifting hero, Beast Boy - to locate their missing animal friends.

videos.title: The Wobble
videos.overview: Wonder Woman, Supergirl, and Bumblebee compete in Super Hero High's gymnastics competition. Wonder Woman is upset after she "wobbles" on her balance beam dismount landing. But when an angry Bleez crashes the competition, Wonder Woman uses The Wobble to her advantage to defeat her.

videos.title: Rolling Blunder
videos.overview: When Big Barda reluctantly joins the Roller Derby team, the bout against the Furies threatens to demolish Metropolis.

videos.title: Target Practice
videos.overview: Starfire discovers a brand new Earth game which she'll use to defend her friends Wonder Woman and Supergirl from Kryptomites.

videos.title: Mindscape
videos.overview: When a mysterious force traps Bumblebee inside a dream, Miss Martian must go inside her friend's mind and free her.

videos.title: For The Girl Who Has Everything
videos.overview: Supergirl attempts to fix the things that frustrate her in order to have a perfect world. But, is a perfect world really what anyone wants?

videos.title: Missing Martian
videos.overview: Miss Martian wants everyone to forget her birthday, but she gets a bad surprise when her friends seem more interested in attacking Metropolis.

videos.title: Water Water Nowhere
videos.overview: When Killer Croc breaks the school's water main before a burglary, Mera's the only one there to stop him - and she has no water to use to defend herself.

videos.title: Fortress of Solidarity
videos.overview: It's the holidays at Super Hero High and Supergirl is reminded of how much she misses her parents. In an attempt to quench her homesickness, Supergirl goes to the North Pole where she is attacked by Captain Cold.

videos.title: Super Gift Swap
videos.overview: It's the Super Hero High gift exchange and the DC Super Hero Girls are cautious of Harley's ticking gift.

videos.title: My So-Called Anti-Life
videos.overview: Dr. Seid's real identity is revealed after he uses the Math Club as a ruse to solve the Anti-Life Equation.
